## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally
- [ ] Timing or caption changes have a Vitest test
- [ ] No voiced audio, music, stock images or font files added
- [ ] Example content is made up (no real people, companies, numbers or keys)
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under "Unreleased"
